summary: MODERN TERRACE Located within walking distance to the town centre and with easy access to the A66 for commuting. This spacious home is ideal for a family or couple and ready to move straight into. Property comprises of - entrance hallway, large living room with fire place, dining room, modern fitted kitchen with oven and hob and fridge freezer, to the first floor are three bedrooms, two double bedrooms and one good size single. Newly fitted bathroom with shower over the bath. Private yard to the rear. On street parking.
